# Deliberately unsound checker: call does NOT widen facts
class BadChecker(diff.RecChecker):
    def expr(self,e,env,facts):

import json, random, sys, itertools, multiprocessing as mp
sys.path.insert(0,'/app'); sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/fuzz')
import genmod
from diff import check_divergence
from language import validate, kind
from checker import check

INT,TEXT,BOOL,UNIT='int','text','bool','unit'
VALUES={INT:[0,1,-3,99,2,5],TEXT:["","a","q"],BOOL:[True,False],UNIT:[None]}

def worker(seedrange,q):
    div=acc=tested=0
    for seed in seedrange:
        try:p=genmod.gen(seed)
        except Exception:continue
        try:validate(p)
        except Exception:continue
        tested+=1
        try:check(p)
        except Exception:continue
        acc+=1
        inames=list(p['inputs'])
        pools=[VALUES[kind(p['inputs'][n])] for n in inames]
        combos=list(itertools.product(*pools)) if inames else [()]
        if len(combos)>20:combos=random.Random(seed).sample(combos,20)
        for combo in combos:
            p2=json.loads(json.dumps(p))
            for n,v in zip(inames,combo):p2['inputs'][n]=v
            out=check_divergence(p2)
            if out is None:continue
            status,bad=out
            if bad:
                div+=1
                with open(f'/tmp/fuzz/div_{seed}.json','w') as f:json.dump(p2,f)
                q.put((seed,combo,status,[b[3] for b in bad[:4]]))
    q.put(('done',tested,acc,div))

def main():
    total=int(sys.argv[1]);nw=10
    chunk=total//nw
    q=mp.Queue()
    procs=[]
    for i in range(nw):
        pr=mp.Process(target=worker,args=(range(i*chunk,(i+1)*chunk),q))
        pr.start();procs.append(pr)
    done=0;
